waiver_rationale: WAIVED BY THE MAINTAINER (FortitudeEtc) on 2026-10-13 and again on 2026-10-15; the approval dates and the review deadline are governance facts supplied by the maintainer, not code-verifiable. INDEPENDENT ADJUDICATION: gpt-6-astra (Codex), independent of the author, 2026-10-15. Round 1 REJECTED the earlier 24-hour form (band CRITICAL). After the fixes below, round 2 derived band HIGH (I1/I3, E4/E5, no uplift) and gave ACCEPT-WITH-CHANGES: the maintainer may reasonably accept the bounded residual as a recorded release decision; HIGH stays gating, and neither that opinion nor this waiver authorizes a release by itself. FIXED: cached signing keys are never trusted for more than one hour after the last successful nonempty store (kJwksMaxKeyAge, equal to kJwksCacheTtl); a token naming an unmatched kid, or carrying an empty or non-string kid, is refused (the first-key fallback applies only to a token with no kid member). RESIDUAL: a signing key the IdP has since retired or revoked can still verify ID tokens until the cached set is more than one hour past its last successful nonempty store. This is not an unconditional revocation deadline: continued publication of the key, delayed concurrent responses and already-selected keys qualify it, and the #1900 fetch-ordering race is retained as an exclusion. The cache is normally refreshed after one hour; an unmatched nonempty kid triggers an earlier fetch; a valid empty or unusable answer does not refresh a nonempty cache. COMPENSATING CONTROLS (confirmed by the adjudicator's code read): RS256/384/512 allowlist, signature, iss, aud, exp and nonce checks; iat and nbf checks are conditional and subject to clock skew; browser binding and single-use state; server-side exchange; discovery validation; TLS and the egress policy; a Settings save (after in-flight sign-ins finish) or a restart replaces the provider and flushes the cache; sessions already issued are not revoked by a key change. APPROVAL IS NOT INDEPENDENT: the maintainer is also the git author of the range. REVIEW BY 2026-11-30 or when #1901 is triaged with a priority, whichever is first; #1901 and #1900 currently carry security, reliability and needs-triage with no priority label. NOT CHANGED HERE, tracked elsewhere: #1900 (single-flight, negative backoff, fetch ordering) and #1901 (alg binding on the cached key, key_ops, duplicate kid handling, RSA size floor).
